summary: Frontend and deployment-prep review completed against the public preview. Commercial Projects content, filtering, empty state, API isolation, labels/links, default residential projects, archived junk-record exclusion, production build, public route smoke tests, and error-free network/console behavior passed. Three release blockers remain: query-only navigation does not refresh commercial SEO, the Hostinger-ready bundle embeds the preview backend URL, and the bundle includes memory/test_credentials.md despite the no-secrets requirement.

integration_issues.flow: Default Projects to Commercial Projects via header dropdown
integration_issues.issue: The page content and API switch to commercial, but document.title and meta description remain the default New Launch SEO. A direct fresh load of the commercial URL sets the correct commercial SEO.

production-hostinger-ready.zip contains frontend/build/static/js/main.113aed28.js with the hardcoded realtor-uploader.preview.emergentagent.com backend URL. Deployed as supplied, frontend API calls bypass the same-origin /api proxy and continue targeting preview.
production-hostinger-ready.zip includes memory/test_credentials.md, violating the explicit requirement to exclude credentials/secrets.

action_items: Make SeoManager react to location.search (or derive and pass the commercial state explicitly), then reapply SEO on /projects query-only navigation in both directions.
Rebuild the Hostinger frontend with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty/same-origin and regenerate production-hostinger-ready.zip; verify no preview domain remains in build assets.
Regenerate the deployment archive with memory/test_credentials.md and every other credential/secret artifact excluded. Consider also excluding tests and cache directories from the production package.
critical_code_review_comments: SeoManager reads window.location.search inside applySeo, but its effect depends only on pathname. React Router navigation from /projects to /projects?category=commercial does not rerun the effect, causing stale title/meta state.
The packaged production JS was built from frontend/.env where REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the public preview domain, so server.js's /api proxy is not used by the supplied build.
The deployment archive filter excludes .env and node_modules but fails to exclude memory/test_credentials.md, exposing credential material in a distributable artifact.
The production build succeeds with warnings; multiple modules still have react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings, including dashboard and admin CRUD pages.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-focused request; public project APIs used for integration checks returned 200)
success_rate.frontend: 82% (commercial/default UI and public route regressions pass; SEO query navigation and two deployment-package requirements fail)

seed_data_creation: None. Public records were read only; no data was created, modified, archived, or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Direct /projects?category=commercial passed exact title/eyebrow/description, title and commercial meta, showed pf-config and no pf-bhk, requested /api/projects?category=commercial&page_size=60 without bhk, and correctly rendered 0 projects plus empty state. Selecting Shop requested config=shop without bhk. Default /projects returned 9 cards, BHK filter, residential-only API records, and no Example Domain records. Header/footer links and terminology passed; homepage contained no Signature Projects. No app console/page errors or HTTP 4xx/5xx occurred. Homepage, Aksh Boulevard detail, /properties, and /login loaded. Fresh default Projects SEO was correct, but default-to-commercial client navigation retained it. yarn build and zip integrity passed. Zip has no node_modules or literal .env files, but contains memory/test_credentials.md and a JS bundle embedding the preview domain.
rca_of_the_issue: SEO defect: SeoManager's useEffect dependency is [pathname], while commercial mode depends on window.location.search; query-only transitions never refetch/reapply SEO. Deployment URL defect: the archive's build was generated with preview REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, which CRA compiled into main.js. Secret leak: the archive creation exclusion rules did not omit the memory credential file. Reproduce SEO by loading /projects, opening Properties > Commercial Projects, and reading document.title/meta description; reproduce package defects with unzip listing and a preview-domain scan of zip entries.
